newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 59 of February 28, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 59 of February 28, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 10 February 1997 concerning the information to be entered in the computerized file of consignments of animals or animal products from third countries which are re-dispatched (Text with EEA relevance) (97/152/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 4 February 1997 recognizing that the production of certain wines in specified regions and of certain vinho regional in Portugal, by reason of their qualitative characteristics, is far from able to satisfy demand (Only the Portuguese text is authentic) (97/151/EC)

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 362/97 of 27 February 1997 suspending the preferential customs duties and re-establishing the Common Customs Tariff duty on imports of multiflorous (spray) carnations originating in Israel

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 361/97 of 27 February 1997 altering the rate of refunds applicable for certain products of the cereals and rice sectors exported in the form of goods not covered by Annex II to the Treaty
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 360/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing the export refunds on cereals and on wheat or rye flour, groats and meal
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 359/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing production refunds on cereals and rice
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 358/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing the export refunds on cereal-based compound feedingstuffs
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 357/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing the export refunds on products processed from cereals and rice

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 356/97 of 27 February 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 2993/94 fixing the aid for the supply of milk products to the Canary Islands under the arrangements provided for in Articles 2 to 4 of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1601/92

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 355/97 of 27 February 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 2219/92 laying down detailed rules for the application of the specific supply arrangements for Madeira relating to milk products regarding the amounts of aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 354/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing the export refunds on milk and milk products
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 353/97 of 27 February 1997 determining the world market price for unginned cotton and the rate for the aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 352/97 of 27 February 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 351/97 of 27 February 1997 fixing export refunds on fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION DECISION No 350/97/ECSC of 17 December 1996 amending Annex V to Decision No 3/96/ECSC on administering certain restrictions on imports of certain steel products from Russia and Ukraine

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 349/97 of 27 February 1997 determining the extent to which import licence applications submitted in February 1997 under the tariff quotas for beef provided for in the Agreements on free trade between the Community, of the one part, and Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia, of the other part, may be accepted.
